scope: A new choice to hide your own Chrome while Companion uses it.

topics.title: Hide your own Chrome
details: In Options, Web browser, there is a new choice called Your own Chrome window.
Choose Hide it while Companion uses it. Then a Chrome window that Companion opens stays off the screen, the taskbar and Alt+Tab.
Companion still reads every page to you, and sound and video still play.
Say show browser window to bring it back. Say hide browser window to hide it again.
A page that needs you, such as a sign-in, brings it back by itself.

topics.title: Your own Chrome windows are safe
details: This choice is off unless you turn it on.
A Chrome window you opened yourself is never hidden.
